forbid.note: MEASURED PHANTOM: `req.parameters.get("id")` in the handler body matches the `.get(` route needle

note: Vapor, the dominant Swift server framework: `app.get("users", ":id", use: getUser)` with the canonical `req.parameters.get("id")` in the handler. BASELINE (0.4.18 wheel): scan_vapor_routes drops the ':' so the route reads `GET /users/id` (a literal segment, which is why the GET call does not pair), mints a phantom `GET /id` from `req.parameters.get("id")`, and emits no HANDLED_BY. client/api.ts is a byte-copy of fixtures/ts-http-fetch/client/api.ts (fetch GET /users/${id}, POST /users) so HTTP_CALLS has a counterparty; ENDPOINT is not an http_server kind, so the client never moves this cell.
